'''''Dendrocalamus''''' is a [[Tropics|tropical]] [[Asia]]n [[genus]] of giant clumping [[bamboo]]s in the [[Poaceae|grass family]].<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/2202#page/477/mode/1up Nees von Esenbeck, Christian Gottfried Daniel. 1835.  Linnaea 9(4): 476–477] in Latin</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40023463 Tropicos, ''Dendrocalamus'' Nees]</ref> It is found in the [[Indian subcontinent]], [[China]], and [[Southeast Asia]].<ref>[http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=109555 Flora of China, Vol. 22 Page 39, <big>牡竹属</big> mu zhu shu ''Dendrocalamus'' Nees, Linnaea. 9: 476. 1835. ]</ref>

''[[Dendrocalamus giganteus]]'' is one of the tallest of bamboos, capable of reaching heights up to 46 m.<ref>Bamboos Of India, {{cite web |url=http://www.inbar.int/publication/txt/tr17/ |title=MAIN |accessdate=2007-06-08 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20070928080139/http://www.inbar.int/publication/txt/tr17/ |archivedate=2007-09-28 }}. Accessed 8 June 2007</ref><ref>[http://www.bioone.org/doi/abs/10.5735/085.046.0612?journalCode=anbf Bioone]</ref>
